protocol: Whole-body suit development in the Ohio State University hypobaric chamber. The nominal test 4-3 plateau was 80,000 ft equivalent at 20.9 mmHg. The report describes usual oxygen preparation of 120 minutes by mask and 45 minutes during dressing. For test 4-3 the authors describe almost three hours of denitrogenation, with no exact case-specific duration.
outcome_window: Foot pain began during test 4-3 and subsided during repressurization. The authors report no post-test sequelae. A fixed follow-up duration is unavailable.
locator: Test 4-3 Results and Figure 46, printed pp. 91–92 (PDF pp. 98–99)
note: One source-labeled bends event in test subject C. Pain began 26 minutes after test start, approximately five minutes into the target plateau. The report gives 42 minutes for the entire test. Laterality and independent diagnostic adjudication are unavailable.
